context.who_uses: Besucher von 741.studio (öffentlich), Martin liest die Leads im Portal

limits: Daten bleiben in der EU (Supabase EU-Region)

milestones.title: Anfrage kommt sicher an
milestones.exit: alle must-Kriterien in M1 bestehen mit Beleg

milestones.title: Barrierefrei und spam-fest
milestones.exit: alle must-Kriterien in M2 bestehen mit Beleg

criteria.text: Given a visitor fills name, email and message, When she submits, Then one row appears in public.leads with these values and source = 'kontakt'
criteria.measure: exactly 1 new row per submit, fields equal to the input

verify.how: Playwright test kontakt.spec.ts submits the form and reads public.leads via service key

criteria.text: The anon key can insert into public.leads but cannot select, update or delete rows
criteria.measure: select/update/delete with anon key return 0 rows or permission error

verify.how: psql as anon role runs select/update/delete on public.leads, all denied

criteria.text: The form shows a link to the privacy page and states the purpose of the data before submit
criteria.measure: link to /datenschutz/ and purpose sentence visible above the submit button

verify.how: Playwright checks the link href and the purpose text

criteria.text: Every field has a visible label and an error message that names the field
criteria.measure: axe-core reports 0 violations of rules label and aria-input-field-name

criteria.text: A hidden honeypot field filled by a bot blocks the insert
criteria.measure: submit with honeypot filled -> 0 new rows, HTTP 200 without hint

verify.how: Playwright fills the honeypot and counts rows

tasks.title: Form markup, labels, privacy text, honeypot
